rationale: David brings deep expertise in shipping autonomous systems and real-time infrastructure (WebRTC, LiveKit, computer vision) from a decade of production robotics work at Skycatch and Agtonomy, while Konstantin's brand entertainment and product placement background at DreamInk represents a complementary lens on how physical AI systems integrate into consumer-facing experiences. As a judge with rare end-to-end autonomous systems shipping experience, David could offer valuable technical mentorship and infrastructure perspective to hackers building physical AI, while Konstantin's brand and entertainment domain knowledge could spark conversations about commercialization and consumer touchpoints.
intro_message: Konstantin, meet David Chen — GM of Robotics at LiveKit and former CTO/Head of R&D at autonomous systems companies (Skycatch, Agtonomy). David's shipped production robotics and built real-time infrastructure for physical AI; you might find his perspective on the intersection of autonomous systems and consumer-facing products valuable during the hackathon.
